---
name: release-notes
description: Checklist for preparing Pinecone release notes. Use when asked to draft or review release notes or a changelog.
---
1. Generate the notes from the release (merged pull requests, contributors, full changelog link).
2. Check that every pull request is in the right category from `.github/release.yml`.
3. Call out breaking changes first.
4. Make sure each item links its work item (`AB#<id>`).
